./gradlew assembleArm64Release
find . -name '*.apk'
git clone -b v0.3.0 https://github.com/obfusk/reproducible-apk-tools.git
reproducible-apk-tools/zipalign.py --page-size 16 --pad-like-apksigner --replace app/build/outputs/apk/arm64/release/*unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
